water.name: Pond
water.title: Pond
lines: Water cells can't hold a tile.

mystery.name: Mystery numbers
mystery.title: Mystery numbers
lines: A lily pad hides a number.
Find it by elimination: it's the number missing from the board and the tray.
Place a tile next to it and the pad opens.

portal.name: Twin portals
portal.title: Twin portals
lines: Two portals of the same colour are linked, one-way.
A down arrow marks the entrance, an up arrow marks the exit.
The smaller number sits on the entrance and the next number comes out of the exit.

lock.name: Locked cells
lock.title: Locked cells
lines: A padlock shows how many more cells you must solve.
Solve that many cells anywhere on the board and the lock opens.
